name: Eclipse Breech
description: Carry the fowling piece in the twin-court posture with both hands apart and the eye ready.

name: Pattern Crown
description: Fire into a court doorway so the spread fills it from post to post.

name: Magnificent Wad
description: Fire on the second footfall so the shot lands with the whole stride behind it.

name: Storied Buckshot
description: Sweep a hall with measured spreads to keep its occupants down.

name: Squallbead
description: Parry high with the barrel and fire low in the same pair of motions.

name: Bead Gift
description: Recharge in the pair of steps used to cross a court floor.

name: Magma Slug
description: Fire two linked spreads so the second fills what the first left open.

name: Steelpump
description: Pack the load with qi to pierce a guard's shield and the arm behind it.

name: Pulsarbead
description: Flash across the floor to the foe's flank and discharge the spread at his guard.

name: Searing Pellet
description: Gather the two tracks of the school into one closing spread that the court teaches as its finishing blow.

name: Solar Sawnedge
description: Pool the pellets at the base of the load like water gathering in a basin.

name: Adamant Choke
description: Sink into a low basin brace so the kick settles into the hips.

name: Pumpgrip Blessing
description: Take aim along the rim of the barrel and mark the foe upon it.

name: Pulsarshell
description: Fire as the load spills over the lip of the basin in one clean shot.

name: Entropy Blast
description: Fire two basin-gathered spreads in pair so the second fills the first's gaps.

name: Shell Decree
description: Let the pooled qi overflow into the pellets and burst through a thin guard.

name: Bedrock Spreadshot
description: Step along the edge of the foe's ground and keep the muzzle inside its curve.

name: Statute Slugchamber
description: Keep the guard still as water so a blow is lost in the qi about the barrel.

name: Tempestuous Slugchamber
description: Pour the pooled qi through a rolling run of spreads that floods the front of a foe.

name: Thunderclap Doublebarrel
description: Strike twice at the rim of a shield so the paired plugs break it open.

name: Storied Pump
description: Draw all the pooled qi from the depth of the basin and drive it through foe and cover.

name: Magnificent Blast
description: Let the two basins of the school overflow into one blast that the treatise teaches as its finishing stroke.

name: Spectral Pellet
description: Stalk along a river's run with soft steps and the barrel held low.

name: Hospitable Breech
description: Mark foes at the water's edge by the ripples they send out.

name: Squall Slug
description: Lead the shot ahead of a foe wading the current.

name: Solarchoke
description: Fire a broken spread like water over rapids that leaves no stone unstruck.

name: Stately Doublebarrel
description: Hold in a still pool beside the current with the muzzle trained out.

name: Deluge Sawnedge
description: Cross a ford in quick steps while the piece is held above the water.

name: Season Wad
description: Flush a wading foe with a spread across the water to break his footing.

name: Lordly Bead
description: Build qi like a river in spate and release it in a surge that sweeps the bank.

name: Spreadshot Crown
description: Fire at the foot of a bank so the earth gives way beneath the foe.

name: Radiance Shell
description: Quicken like a river in flood and flash to the foe's side to fire at once.

name: Imperial Pattern
description: Gather the whole run of the river into a final cast that the art teaches as its closing stroke.

name: Pealchoke
description: Watch the foe from two angles like paired hawks and fix the muzzle where they meet.

name: Evanescent Buckshot
description: Lean into a short swoop and fire as the footing settles.

name: Wadverdict
description: Fire a tight load that strikes with two points like paired talons.

name: Blastdecree
description: Split a spread into two wings that close upon a foe from either side.

name: Pealbead
description: Parry on the perch and return the shot from the same stance.

name: Peal Shell
description: Hover in a held stance to read the foe's weakness through qi before firing.

name: Fearless Choke
description: Drop upon the foe from a height with a pierced load that drives through his guard.

name: Intrepid Sawnedge
description: Circle a foe at distance firing from each quarter so he has no covered side.

name: Season Pump
description: Rush upon the foe in a flash of paired strides and discharge at the instant of contact.

name: Royal Vacuum Bead
description: Join both hawk strikes in one closing blow that the doctrine teaches as the finishing shot of its school.

name: Luminous Slugchamber
description: Rest the muzzle on the line where the two qi tracks of the body meet.

name: Pumpvoyage
description: Shift weight along one track while the other holds the piece still.

name: Blast Edict
description: Fire when both tracks run level so the shot leaves with no sway.

name: Prismshell
description: Crouch with both tracks drawn tight to take a heavy blow and keep the aim.

name: Dauntless Pump
description: Run qi down both tracks into the load so the spread opens wide and even.

name: Parity Pumpgrip
description: Cross the tracks in the forearms to turn a blade away from the barrel.

name: Magnanimous Doublebarrel
description: Pulse qi along the tracks so the recharge is finished before the foe moves.

name: Venombead
description: Strike the foe's qi track with a sudden blast so his stance breaks.

name: Millstone Wad
description: Run both tracks in turn so one fires as the other recharges without a break.

name: Magma Pellet
description: Send the full draw of both tracks into one spread that bursts a cover and its keepers.

name: Thunderclap Pattern
description: Flash along one track to the foe and fire along the other upon arrival.

name: Demolition Buckshot
description: Unite both tracks into one great blast that the canon teaches as the finishing stroke of the school.

name: Merciful Pumpgrip
description: Read the shape of an open spread against the sky and shift the muzzle to match it.

name: Consecrated Pumpgrip
description: Open the stance wide with the piece loose in the hands and the frame set to take its kick.

name: Magnificent Choke
description: Fire a broad spread beneath an open sky so it fans with no barrier in its way.

name: Solarpellet
description: Draw qi from the Core into the load so the spread opens with force from its heart.

name: Steelpellet
description: Pulse the Core outward through the arms to harden them against a heavy blow.

name: Deluge Spreadshot
description: Slip along the edge of the foe's reach in a hawk's long glide.

name: Solarshell
description: Light the charge with a spark struck from the Core so it burns at once.

name: Matchless Slug
description: Pour wave upon wave of Core-driven spreads across a field until its foes are scattered.

name: Vacuum Breech
description: Narrow the force of the Core into a needle of pellets that pierces guard and body.

name: Season Slug
description: Flash from a height in a Core-driven blur and fire the spread as the feet touch earth.

name: Blastbanner
description: Free the whole Core into a single unbound spread that the treatise teaches as its closing stroke.
